title: Synaptic Needle Amulet

sources.title: Mind Tax
markers: | description = Cleave into a {{Cond|Charmed}} or {{Cond|Frightened}} foe's brain tissue and invigorate your body.

fields.Mind Tax: Bonus Action once per Short Rest, 60 ft. Targets a Charmed or Frightened enemy, deals 1d10 Psychic and grants 8 temporary HP to the wearer. Temporary HP does not stack.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
